name: SLB Limited
reason: Oilfield services earnings set by upstream capex and oil prices: 10y EPS CAGR -1.4%, EPS fell 66% in 2016 and 54% in 2020, and consensus FY1 -16.5%; high FCF yield is cyclical, not special.

name: SmartStop Self Storage REIT
reason: Self-storage REIT with GAAP losses in most years, share count +23%/yr, acquisitions 1.2x FCF and net debt/EBITDA 8.1x; growth has been bought with equity and leverage.

name: Snap-on
reason: Franchised mobile-van tool channel with 10y EPS CAGR 9%, ROIC ~16%, net cash, only -5% EPS in 2020 and minimal M&A (acq 0.07x FCF); caveat: EPS 0.98x 10y max with margin near 10y high, so growth to 7%+ relies on buybacks plus modest volume.

name: Snap
reason: Never GAAP-profitable (EBIT margin -9% at best), ad business losing share to Meta/TikTok, and FCF is flattered by stock comp; consensus EPS growth negative.

name: Simon Property Group
reason: Mall/outlet REIT with FFO/share CAGR only 2.3% over 10y, FFO 0.95x its 10y peak, and net debt/EBITDA 12.3x on FactSet data; durable but no route to 7%/yr growth.

name: Sphere Entertainment
reason: Single-venue Las Vegas Sphere plus declining MSG Networks regional sports TV; losses in most years (EBIT margin -7.6%) and outcome hinges on replicating one novel venue.

name: SPS Commerce
reason: Retail EDI network with 10y EPS CAGR 26% and net cash, but growth is decelerating sharply, acquisitions were 0.8x FCF and adj-vs-GAAP gap ~63%, so the 5-10y organic growth rate is unclear.

name: SPX Technologies
reason: EBIT margin at 10y high (16.8%, 100th pctile) after a sharp run-up and acquisitions were 2.0x cumulative FCF; growth is M&A-driven rather than core, with adj-vs-GAAP gap ~159%.

name: Sempra
reason: Regulated utility with net debt/EBITDA 6.2x, persistently negative FCF (conversion -1.2x), 5y EPS CAGR only 3.2% with shares +2.7%/yr, plus California wildfire and LNG project risk.

name: STAG Industrial
reason: Industrial REIT whose FFO/share grew only 5.5%/yr while shares grew 10.9%/yr (equity-funded acquisition growth), net debt/EBITDA 5.2x and consensus FY2-3 FFO growth ~0%.

name: Sterling Infrastructure
reason: Site-development contractor at peak: EPS 1.0x 10y max and EBIT margin at 10y high (16.6% vs 6.6% avg) after a run-up driven by data-center capex that cannot be forecast 5-10 years out.

name: Seagate Technology
reason: Cyclical HDD duopoly at peak: FY26 EPS 1.0x 10y max with EBIT margin 34.7% vs 14.2% 10y avg, after EPS collapsed 98% in FY23; revenue flat over 10y.

name: Sunbelt Rentals Holdings
reason: Scale equipment-rental leader (ex-Ashtead) but earnings track nonresidential construction cycles, EPS has fallen three straight years to 0.83x peak, and only four years of US-listed history.

name: Savers Value Village
reason: Thrift retailer with net debt/EBITDA 6.2x, EPS down to 0.09x its peak (0.14 in 2025) and margin compressed from 15% to 7.9%; balance sheet and trend fail.

name: Skyworks Solutions
reason: RF semis with heavy Apple single-customer exposure and share loss: EPS 0.53x 10y peak, EBIT margin at 9th pctile (12.8%), 5y EPS CAGR -0.7%, plus a transformative Qorvo merger.

name: Southwest Gas Holdings
reason: Gas utility mid-transformation after separating Centuri (2025 margin jump to 24.4% is deconsolidation, not core), with negative FCF, 5y EPS CAGR -2.5% and shares +4.3%/yr.

name: Symbotic
reason: Warehouse robotics loss-maker (EBIT margin -3.6%) dependent on Walmart as dominant customer; FCF reflects customer prepayments (working capital), not recurring earnings.

name: Sysco
reason: Durable foodservice scale leader but thin 4.3% EBIT margin at 10y high, net debt/EBITDA 2.8x and LTG only 5.9%; a good-not-special business without a clear 7%+ route.

name: Teladoc Health
reason: Telehealth with losses every year, acquisitions 3.0x FCF (Livongo write-off), shares +24%/yr and consensus EPS declining; BetterHelp faces commoditised competition.

name: Tenable Holdings
reason: Vulnerability-management software only at breakeven GAAP EBIT (0.1%), acquisitions 1.1x FCF and FCF heavily supported by stock comp, in a fast-consolidating security market (CrowdStrike, Wiz/Google).
